notes:
Moagram now counts anonymous active use.

After this update, a phone sends a random install id and the app version at most once a day when it is opened. The report does not include a Telegram account, phone number, or messages. Turn it off under Settings → Moagram Updates → Count this install.
critical_message: This update reports anonymous active use: a random install id and the app version, at most once a day. Your Telegram account, phone number, and messages stay on this phone. You can turn it off under Settings → Moagram Updates → Count this install.
